content.value: Design a rectangular footing of uniform thickness for an axially loaded column of 20 inch x 15 inch in size transmitting a load of 300 Kips. The safe bearing capacity of soil is 2.25 Ksf. Use $f ^ { \prime } { _ { \mathrm { { c } } } } = 3 0 0 0$ psi and $\mathsf { f } _ { \mathsf { s } } = 2 4 0 0 0$ psi. Show the reinforcement details.
